text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #28343a
font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #28343a

g.text: Witch continues walking. Civilian choices begin.
Blood reorients; Bone attends to M05.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #28343a

g.text: The parent and child remain alive.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #28343a

g.text: Blood chooses the growing eastern aid pocket
and makes a short, deliberate advance.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a72c3e

g.text: One broad surge. Four fatalities, two new injuries.
Supported pair has continued out of its footprint.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #28343a

g.text: Local impact/sound can register. Stop now.
No subsequent civilian decision is chosen.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #28343a

g.text: Four new fatalities. Two previously injured people die; two helpers are newly injured.
The surviving injury count stays four. Event marks are not final corpse poses.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #28343a

g.text: Earliest optimistic contact bound is after +122 at the same pace.
Do not extend this pass merely to demonstrate the barrier.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #28343a

g.text: Red: Blood advance / broad force envelope. Darker red: central force. Violet: one precise Bone incident. Teal: the unchanged main-road Witch route.
Ochre: already-chosen civilian motion. Pink: damage only where these actions physically intersect existing objects.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #60716b

g.text: The Witch is about 1 m behind the wave envelope at impact; no split/meld event is forced. No building footprint is intersected by this strike.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #60716b

g.text: Same healthy survey, map north = UE +X / uphill. Horizontal metres. No UE edits, final damage assets, full escape paths or Step 5 reactions.
